concept_thesis: A high-commitment level charge meets rising terrain. Each higher tread must earn support before horizontal momentum may be redirected vertically; after the final height gate releases, retained horizontal charge overruns the top and is paid by a long catch, shorter correction, and displaced settle.

source.title: Bullwinkle
source.game: The Adventures of Rocky and Bullwinkle and Friends
observed: The commissioned static source sheet is 187×432 and labels four whole-character families: Charge, Idle, Using Stairs, Walking.
The family contrast includes ordinary level travel, high-commitment level travel, rest, and discrete-height locomotion.
The commissioned evidence records zero animated GIFs and therefore grants no source-authentic playback cadence.
inferred: Locomotion018 authors an upward stair-entry problem by combining the semantic contrast between Charge and Using Stairs; the direction and choreography are not copied from source art.
All decisive cadence, support ownership, root travel, COM response, and recovery debt are authored INFERRED under STREET_FIGHTER-CAPCOM timing.

keys.name: CHARGE_LOAD
keys.causal_role: High-commitment forward load begins on level ground; rear/right support owns propulsion.

keys.name: LAST_LEVEL_PUSH
keys.causal_role: Last level push lengthens horizontal spacing before terrain discontinuity.

keys.name: RISER_1_PROBE
keys.causal_role: Lead/left foot discovers higher support while root remains low and charge continues.

keys.name: RISER_1_EARNS_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: Mixed-height dual support authorizes the first rise; root is held before lift.

keys.name: REDIRECT_LIFT_1
keys.causal_role: Horizontal charge is redirected upward only after high support earns authority.

keys.name: REAR_RELEASE_1
keys.causal_role: Low rear support releases after root rises; swing leg chases the next tread.

keys.name: RISER_2_PROBE
keys.causal_role: Next higher tread is probed without granting it support ownership.

keys.name: RISER_2_EARNS_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: Second mixed-height split authorizes another vertical redirection; root holds.

keys.name: REDIRECT_LIFT_2
keys.causal_role: Second high support converts retained horizontal intent into rise.

keys.name: REAR_RELEASE_2
keys.causal_role: Trailing leg releases and crosses toward the third tread while cadence remains continuous.

keys.name: RISER_3_PROBE
keys.causal_role: Third higher contact arrives before root height changes.

keys.name: RISER_3_EARNS_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: Third mixed-height support split gates the next rise.

keys.name: REDIRECT_LIFT_3
keys.causal_role: Third redirection climbs sharply; head and arms lag the upward root impulse.

keys.name: TOP_PROBE
keys.causal_role: Top tread is reached by a long probe while lower support still owns the body.

keys.name: TOP_EARNS_SUPPORT
keys.causal_role: Top contact earns authority; the root is again held before the final rise.

keys.name: TOP_RELEASE_SURGE
keys.causal_role: Freed from vertical gating, residual charge produces a sudden horizontal spacing spike.

keys.name: OVERTRAVEL
keys.causal_role: Root overruns the top support; torso and arms continue forward after the climb is complete.

keys.name: CATCH_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: Long forward catch step arrests the overrun by compressing the root downward and counterleaning.

keys.name: SHORT_CORRECTION
keys.causal_role: A shorter correction step pays remaining forward debt without resetting phase.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.causal_role: Settle finishes displaced beyond the stair entry with residual arm/head lag rather than idle reset.

quality_evidence.inspection_surface: all 20 unique authored decisive render states; 36-frame MP4 contains authored key holds only

tango.highest_value_visible_check: Each higher tread is visibly probed while the lower support still owns the root; rise follows only after mixed-height support authorization. Final top release produces a large horizontal spacing spike, overtravel, catch compression, shorter correction, and displaced settle.

noodle_queen.taste: The repeated low/high split supports form a specific stair-entry sentence rather than a generic walk cycle.
noodle_queen.function: Horizontal charge is visibly converted into gated vertical travel and then released into top-tread overrun/catch debt.
noodle_queen.contempt: No decorative source imitation, generic stair label, equal-spacing gait, or cheap idle return survives.
